newsitem.title: USA: Etec Systems names Snyder CFO.
newsitem.headline: Etec Systems names Snyder CFO.

text.p: Etec Systems Inc, a maker of products for the semiconductor industry, Tuesday said it named William Snyder as its chief financial officer, replacing Phil Koen who left in June to join another company.
Snyder joins Etec from his position as chief financial officer of Integrated Device Technology Inc.

"We look forward to the advantages of both his semiconductor industry knowledge and his financial experience in larger companies," Steve Cooper, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "This experience should prove instrumental to our continued growth."
